description: test_lib.py does not test the min_edge boundary itself (edge == min_edge exactly, e.g. estimated_prob=0.65, price=0.5, min_edge=0.15 -> edge is exactly 0.15) even though the code's comparison is a strict '<' (position_size returns non-zero when edge==min_edge). Only edge<min_edge (0.1<0.15) is tested. Also untested: kelly_fraction's upper bound near-certainty case (e.g. estimated_prob=0.99, price=0.01) to lock in that full-Kelly can approach but never exceed 1.0, and arb_pair_profit at the exact boundary ask_yes or ask_no == 1.0 (excluded by the strict '<1.0' guard) is never exercised.
